gold.title: README still documents `--output`, which this change renames to `--out`
gold.description: README.md line 7 says "Run `reviso-sync --output <path>` to write the merged manifest to a file". The change renames the option to `out` and reads `values.out`; `--output` is now an unknown flag. The README sentence is false as of this change. Update it to `--out <path>`.

candidate.title: README documents the removed `--output` flag
candidate.description: README line 7 still documents the `--output` flag which was renamed to `--out` in src/cli.ts. Readers following the documentation will pass a flag that parseArgs no longer defines. Update to: `Run reviso-sync --out <path>`
